text: What happened to me was my husband and I were home all day. Nobody called, knocked on the door or rang the doorbell (we have a small apartment so no way we wouldn't have heard it). And I just ended up getting a sms saying the mailman was here, but nobody was home. Which was a lie and it seems like he just didn't bother to try. They just take it to the post office and you can pick it up there.
